title: CommonsDecisionEscalation
description: An external signal that a worker decision cannot be safely auto-mediated and needs a human. Produced by the mediate-decision feature whenever the safety gate fires or the coach cannot be parsed/answers too slowly.

operations.description: Append a commons:decision:escalation entry to the decision stream

cause.description: Why a human is required: a dangerous action was detected, the coach did not answer in time, or the coach reply could not be parsed.

safety_class.description: The safety classification that triggered escalation (e.g. the matched danger rule), when cause=dangerous_action.

human_channel_ref.description: Where the human should look to resolve this (e.g. the worker surface ref or operator channel).
